thread:
Sam: Heads up — ACME asked if we can add a 'priority burst' add-on: 2x throughput for 1 hour / day, plus a soft SLA for reduced contention. They want it in contract next week. :grimacing:
Maya: What exactly does '2x throughput' mean for them? Peak QPS or sustained tokens/sec?
Jess: Sales note: customer is asking because they have marketing spikes. They're willing to pay ~30% premium if it's guaranteed. They're also pushing for credits if we fail to deliver.
Leo: From infra side, 2x sustained is basically doubling slot reservations during the window. That impacts scheduling and multipool fairness. We can do a temporary capacity reservation but cost -> ops.
Ruth: Finance: 30% premium seems low if we have to reserve GPUs. Also credits on miss could be big exposure. Need hard failure definitions.
Maya: Proposed framing: make it an "elastic burst" add-on with explicit limits: max concurrency, burst window (60m), cooldown (6h), and a failure SLA defined as >10% percent of requests degraded.
Sam: Customer wants a mitigation clause: if we can't serve, they want either credits or fallback model at same latency. We should avoid open-ended credits.
Jess: We can offer two options to the customer: (A) Non-guaranteed burst with priority routing for 30% premium (no credits) or (B) Guaranteed reserved burst for 60% premium + limited credit on SLA miss (capped).
Leo: Technical constraints to call out to product:
- Reservation requires pinned capacity per customer for the reserved option.
- Autoscaler currently can't pin per-customer on the Dedicated pool without manual overrides.
- KV cache priming for warm-up (~10-20% cold-token penalty first 30s).

Maya: For launch criteria we need:
1) Feature flag + console toggle for "elastic burst"
2) Config schema: {"burst_hours":60, "max_concurrency": X, "cooldown_hours":6, "reserved_capacity": bool}
3) Billing meter defined and tested in staging
4) Clear SLA language and a credits cap in contract

Sam: Can engineering estimate work & risk? Also need an expected P50/P95 latency impact when burst is active.

Leo: Quick sketch from infra: 2-3 devs, ~3 sprints to add pinning + autoscaler hooks + trace dashboards. Risk: priority routing might starve other customers; need policy for preemption. P95 could jump 10-40ms depending on model size and queueing.

Ruth: From revenue ops: credits cap should be either fixed dollar amount (e.g., monthly cap = 2x monthly fee for add-on) or percentage of invoice (e.g., max 25%). Prefer fixed dollar cap for predictability.

Jess: Customer is more comfortable with a hard cap. I'll push option B with a capped credit.

ops-bot: Current observed utilization on dedicated pools last 30d:
```
median_usage: 64%
95p_usage: 89%
peak_hourly_burst_events: 4 per day (avg)
```

Maya: Action items:
- Jess to confirm which option ACME prefers by EOD tomorrow (@Jess)
- Leo to validate autoscaler feasibility and give a firm estimate by Fri (@Leo)
- Ruth to propose credit cap language and numeric suggestion (@Ruth)
- Sam to draft product spec skeleton for "elastic burst" with launch checklist (@Sam)

Jess: Will do. If they push hard we may want a pilot first (one region) and a higher premium. :+1:
Maya: Agreed — pilot with region limit and telemetry gating. If telemetry shows >5% collateral impact we rollback.
Sam: OK — I'll start a short spec and share here. Thanks all.
